description: In this discussion-based seminar, students hone their literary-critical skills through study of seventeenth-century British literature, highlighting the works of John Milton, author of Paradise Lost, as well as Lucy Hutchinson, Andrew Marvell, Aphra Behn, George Herbert, Katherine Philips, Margaret Cavendish, and John Donne. The course also introduces historical context, including the English Civil Wars and Restoration. Students write literary analyses based on original thinking and reading of scholarly criticism. Prerequisites: ENGL 185 plus at least two English courses at level II, or permission of the instructor.
fullname: Advanced Studies in Literary Eras: British
